violations.text: Various food was observed held between 44-50 degrees Fahrenheit in the open-air unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were observed pushed too far up front, causing a rise in temperature. Open air unit was observed holding an ambient temperature of 38-41 DF. All food in unit was evaluated and either voluntarily disposed of or moved back to the colder part of unit. Establishment is to monitor the food temperatures in the open-air unit and ensure that all food is pushed back enough to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine cover have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The floor in the dry storage area, and under the soda storage area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The front food service area was observed to be lacking an allergy awareness statement that is available for customer viewing. An allergen awareness statement is to be provided. (PIC hand wrote an allergen awareness sign at the time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

Several food items in the open-air cooler were observed held at 42 to 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were rotated and pushed back into colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Employees are to ensure foods are not overstocked and stocked back from the front edge to ensure maintained in the coldest part of refrigeration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

Pastry items packaged in the food establishment are lacking proper complete labels (missing location and address). Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2025

The following equipment was observed to be in need of repair or adjustment... - The 3 bay sink faucet spout was observed with a rubber tube attached (per employee, so as to angle the water into the middle bay without spraying onto the floor). Faucet is to be adjusted for proper design and use. - The retail side entry door to the walk-in cooler was observed to have torn/detached gasket. Gasket is to be repaired/replaced Equipment is to be maintained in good repair and for proper design and use. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2025

The floor in the back soda syrup area was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue and soda syrup. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2025
